best_for: Developers already on Windsurf who need an older build on Windows, or who want to know what changed when it became Devin Desktop.
description:
Windsurf is an AI code editor from Cognition, the company that also makes Devin Cloud, Devin CLI and Devin Review. It is proprietary software, built so that AI agents can plan and write code while you steer.

You can start an agent session on your own machine and later move it to Devin Cloud with the same context, or keep everything local without using Devin at all. For large jobs, one agent can split the work among subagents that each open their own pull requests. Fast Context looks up the files and lines an agent needs, and Devin Review checks each diff from inside the editor. A mode called Fusion pairs a frontier model that leads with a cheaper model that does the routine work, to keep costs down.

points.title: Windsurf is now Devin Desktop
points.text: Cognition renamed Windsurf to Devin Desktop on June 2, 2026. It is the same editor with the same features, now opening on an Agent Command Center for local and cloud AI agents, and the classic Windsurf view is still there.

points.title: The update renames the app
points.text: The change arrives as a normal automatic update. On Windows the program becomes `Devin.exe`, and the `surf` command gives way to `devin-desktop`, though `surf` and `windsurf` still ship. App allowlists that expect the old name may block it.

points.title: Settings carry over
points.text: Plans, settings and extensions move across with the update, so there is nothing to reinstall. The data folder layout comes from VS Code.

points.title: Free with a light quota
points.text: The free plan has a small agent quota, fewer models, and unlimited Tab completions and inline edits. Pro is USD 20 a month and Max USD 200 a month; paid plans get a usage allowance that refreshes daily and weekly. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Windows builds only here
points.text: This site lists only the Windows builds, for x64 and Arm64, each as a per-user or all-users installer. The Windows listing keeps 80 versions. Cognition also ships Mac and Linux builds, which are not listed here.
